name: web-cream-analytics-feature-cards-with-hard-shadows-and-testimonial-grid
title: Butter-cream analytics page: heavy black-outlined chart cards with red keylines, and a grid of five-star quotes
whatItIs: A butter-cream page with a centred heavy headline, five chart cards with thick black outlines and hard shadows each containing a chart panel in a thin red keyline (real-time insights, retention, A/B tests, metrics), a 'Journey, not destination' caption and a second section with a 2x2 grid of centred five-star testimonials with round avatars.
whatItMeans: Friendly and confident; thick outlines make data charts feel like stickers.
techniques: Outline cards in thick black with hard shadow.
Frame charts in thin red keylines.
Cut chart cards off at the bottom.

vocabulary.definition: A card with thick outline and hard shadow.
A thin red border around a chart.
A chart cut by its card edge.
